name: Trouble Chaser Dai 2 Wa - Futarime no Chaser
original_name: トラぶるＣＨＡＳＥＲ 第２話 ２人目のチェイサー
source:
Daiskuke gets accustomed to living with Rena when his house gets demolished again by another space ship landing on it. Rudy comes out of the ship claiming that she's a friend of Rena.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-february-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
大辅逐渐习惯了与蕾娜共同生活，另一艘宇宙飞船却再次降落在他家，把房子又砸毁了一遍。露蒂从飞船中走出，声称自己是蕾娜的朋友。

[引自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.nl/2017/07/vn-of-month-february-1995.html]vndbreview[/url]]
